summary_en: ROE target 6–8% by FY3/27; dividend reinstatement planned for FY3/27 period-end; 152,900 shares acquired May 21–Jun 2, 2026 as shareholder return initiative; profitability, growth in new business (AGV, autonomous cleaning robot), and enhanced IR activity as improvement pillars.
title_en: Response to Realizing Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: On 25 June 2026, Tokyo Kikai Seisakusho's board resolved on measures to realise management conscious of cost of capital and stock price. The company analysed its financial metrics: ROE fell to negative in two of the past five years due to litigation costs and restructuring charges, though latest results have stabilised; PBR remains below 1.0x; PER is depressed. The company aims for ROE of 6–8% by FY3/27 and plans dividend reinstatement by FY3/27 period-end (specific yen/share amount under review). As a shareholder return initiative ahead of dividend resumption, the board on 20 May 2026 authorised acquisition of treasury shares; 152,900 shares were purchased 21 May–2 June 2026. Improvement measures focus on profitability (new next-generation printing press, production scaling), growth (AGV business, autonomous cleaning robot, processing & assembly expansion), and reinforced dialogue with long-term institutional investors. Dividend policy and per-share amount remain subject to finalisation.
